title: blob-server: RFC 8620 §6.3 Blob/copy
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B23. Crates: jmap-blob-server. Size: M.

Optional follow-up from docs/design/blobext.md §11: implement RFC 8620 §6.3 Blob/copy (core, selected by urn:ietf:params:jmap:core, unchanged by RFC 9404 and blobext-03) in jmap-blob-server with a copy_blob(caller, from_account, to_account, blob_id) hook (no default: a no-op would report false copies) and memory support. Response fromAccountId/accountId/copied/notCopied with notFound per RFC 8620. Acceptance: tests for copy between two memory accounts, unknown blob -> notCopied notFound, fromAccountId == accountId behaviour; public-api snapshot.
